signature/tests/test_compatible: Checks the helper Ibis uses to compare Python method signatures.
sql/test_compiler: Snapshot test of the SQL text Ibis generates. ibis-rs writes its own SQL and is checked on results instead.
sql/test_select_sql: Snapshot test of the SQL text Ibis generates. ibis-rs writes its own SQL and is checked on results instead.
sql/test_sql: Snapshot test of the SQL text Ibis generates. ibis-rs writes its own SQL and is checked on results instead.
test_dataframe_interchange: Tests the Python dataframe interchange protocol (__dataframe__).
test_interactive: Tests Ibis's interactive mode: how expressions print in a Python REPL or notebook.
test_markers: Tests the pytest markers of the Ibis suite itself.
test_signatures: Checks that every Python backend class has the same method signatures.
test_sql: Snapshot test of the SQL text Ibis generates. ibis-rs writes its own SQL and is checked on results instead.
test_udf: Tests UDFs written as Python functions.
test_vectorized_udf: Tests UDFs written as Python functions over pandas or PyArrow data.
